sections: Navigation header (Logo, Features, How It Works, Pricing, FAQ, Login CTA, Start Free CTA)

Hero Section: Bold Headline 'One Video. Endless Content.', Subtitle, YouTube URL Input with sample video pills, 'Generate Clips' CTA, and an interactive App Dashboard Preview Showcase with floating AI score tags
Social Proof Banner: 'Trusted by 10,000+ YouTubers, Podcasters & Agencies' with minimalist creator metrics
How It Works (3-step visual workflow: 1. Paste YouTube URL -> 2. AI Magic Highlight & Smart Reframe -> 3. Export 10+ Viral Clips & Content Pack)
Core Capabilities Grid (Bento Style): AI Highlight Detection, Viral Score, Smart 9:16 Reframe, Dynamic Captions, Full Content Pack (Title, Hook, Hashtags, Thumbnail Text), Brand Kit Styling

header.user_profile_dropdown: User avatar, plan tier (PRO), credits, Logout button

stage_processing_screen.concept: Stage-based AI pipeline processing with dynamic progress indicators
stage_processing_screen.visuals: Animated glowing ring, current stage progress bar (0-100%), real-time logs terminal toggle, estimated time remaining counter

results_page.top_bar: Project Title, Original Video Duration, Total Clips Detected (e.g., 12 Clips), Export All Button, Batch Actions
results_page.filters: Category tabs (All, High Potential >85, Hooks, Q&A, Stories), Sort dropdown (Viral Score, Duration, Time in Video)
results_page.grid: Grid of Clip Cards with video thumbnail preview, hover auto-play/preview, duration badge, Viral Potential Score badge, AI Hook quote, quick 'Open Editor' and 'Export' buttons

video_editor.left_tools_panel: Tabs: Captions (Styles, Colors, Fonts, Animations), Crop/Reframe (Auto Speaker, Center, Custom 9:16/1:1), B-Roll/Overlays, Audio/Music, Templates
video_editor.center_preview: 9:16 vertical phone viewport with real-time video playback, draggable caption overlays, active speaker bounding box toggle
video_editor.bottom_timeline: Multi-track timeline slider with Video track, Audio waveform, Caption segments, Highlight markers, Trim handles, Play/Pause, Timestamp counter
video_editor.right_settings: Clip Details, AI Hook & Virality breakdown, Caption Text editing line-by-line, Export Preset selection (1080p, 60fps, Burn-in captions)

content_pack_dashboard.features: Generates 5 ready-to-post assets per clip: AI Video Title, Viral Hook Sentence, Social Caption with Emojis, Hashtag Cloud, Suggested Thumbnail Text & CTA. Includes 'Copy All' and 'Export JSON/Text' buttons

brand_kit.features: Custom font uploader/selector, Primary & Secondary Accent Colors, Watermark/Logo overlay setup, Custom Caption preset templates

general_ui_ux_guidelines.test_id_rule: Every button, input, tab, navigation link, card, and actionable control MUST have a descriptive data-testid attribute in kebab-case format. E.g., data-testid='generate-clips-button', data-testid='youtube-url-input', data-testid='viral-score-badge-1'.
general_ui_ux_guidelines.theme_rule: Enforce dark theme by default using dark class on html element or default dark color tokens.
general_ui_ux_guidelines.no_transparent_overlays: Headers, floating bars, and dropdown menus must use backdrop-blur + semi-opaque surfaces (e.g. bg-[#0B0C10]/80 backdrop-blur-xl), never fully transparent background.
general_ui_ux_guidelines.hover_contrast: Interactive states must explicitly declare contrast text colors, e.g. hover:bg-violet-600 hover:text-white.
general_ui_ux_guidelines.responsive_design: Mobile-first grids, responsive sidebar collapses into slide-over drawer on smaller screens.

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. Build the frontend app using React, Tailwind CSS, Lucide Icons, and Shadcn primitives.
2. Make sure all pages specified in layout_blueprints are accessible and interactive.
3. Provide mock JWT authentication flow (login, register, stored token in localStorage, user profile context).
4. Implement real interactive state transitions: entering a YouTube link initiates the 5-stage processing screen, leading into the results page with clip cards.
5. Ensure the Video Editor is fully functional with tool panels, interactive 9:16 canvas preview, multi-track timeline control, caption style switcher, and export trigger.
6. Apply data-testid to every interactive component across the entire app.
